description: Search and aggregate news articles from multiple sources. Uses NewsAPI.org (if API key configured) or Google News RSS (free, no key). Filter by keyword, category, source, date range, and language.

category.description: News category (only with NewsAPI key, ignored with Google News RSS)

from.description: Start date for articles (YYYY-MM-DD format, NewsAPI only)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-100, default: 10)

query.description: Search keyword or phrase (e.g., 'artificial intelligence', 'climate change')

to.description: End date for articles (YYYY-MM-DD format, NewsAPI only)

name: search_news
